description: Floor-length cream square-neck gown with naturally fitted bodice, elbow sleeves, narrow burgundy geometric woven bands and front walking opening. Plum/burgundy shoulder wrap with gold borders rests along forearms, round shoulder brooches, broad narrow-patterned girdle with round clasp and hanging end. Pendant necklace, bracelet and brown decorated shoes visible under hem. No headgear, armor or weapon.
